column2: Grassroots Organisations And Community Development Councils (End Of Period), Annual

column4: Community Development Councils were formed in 1997.  They were re-structured into 5 CDCs on 24 November 2001.
Citizens' Consultative Committee area committees started in 1983.
Malay Activity Executive Committees were formed in 1995.
Indian Activity Executive Committees were formed in 1998.
Senior Citizens' Executive Committees started in 1986.
Civil Defence Executive Committees were formed in August 1998.  PA renamed the Civil Defence Executive Committee to Community Emergency and Engagement Committee in 2009.

The People's Association (PA) took over the management of the Constituency Sports Club on 1 October 2002.  Constitutency Sports Clubs has been renamed to Community Sports Clubs in 2011.  Community Sports Networks were formed in 2021.
T-Net Club Management Committee was dissolved in 2020.
Building fund committees were formed in 1977.
